'''Kelnacca''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Wookiee]] who served as a [[Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[230 BBY]], Kelnacca was sent to the crash site of the [[Starlight Beacon]] [[space station]] on the [[planet]] [[Eiram]] to help with the relief effort. There, he was introduced to [[Padawan]] [[Yarzion Vell]], whose [[Lulad|master]] had [[Death|died]] in the [[Destruction of Starlight Beacon|crash]], and took him on as his own Padawan. A [[229 BBY|year later]], Kelnacca and Vell [[Skirmish on Vianax|fought]] the [[Nihil]] [[Pirate|marauders]] on the astronomical object [[Vianax]], after which they helped with repairs in a [[Unidentified settlement (Vianax)|settlement]]. In [[228 BBY]], the plague known as the [[blight]] was found on Kelnacca's [[homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk]], and he joined a [[Jedi]] [[Kashyyyk team|team]] [[Mission to Kashyyyk (blight)|sent]] to the planet. During the mission, Kelnacca joined a [[meditation team]] working to slow the spread of the blight. It was later discovered that a patch of the blight was extending toward a [[White wroshyr grove|grove]] that secretly contained the last surviving scared [[white wroshyr tree]]s.

Following the discovery, Kelnacca attended a meeting in which the Wookiees decided to reveal the existence of the [[tree]]s to the Jedi. Along with fellow Wookiee Jedi [[Burryaga Agaburry|Burryaga]], Kelnacca lead the Jedi team to the grove, where they discovered a [[Sith artifact]] known as the [[thornseed]]. The next [[Local day|day]], Kelnacca helped defend the [[Pruzzalla's village|village]] the team was staying in when it was attacked by the [[carnivorous plant]]s known as the [[Drengir]]. Realizing the attack was a distraction created by Nihil [[scientist]] [[Zadina Mkampa]], the team traveled back to the white wroshyr grove, where they battled Mkampa and the Drengir. With the Jedi unable to defeat them, Kelnacca and Burryaga communed with the white wroshyr trees, who convinced the Drengir to turn to the [[light side of the Force]]. As a result of the trees' power, the blight on Kashyyyk was healed.

Later that [[Standard year|year]], Kelnacca and Vell formed an alliance with a [[Tempest Breakers|group]] of [[bounty hunter]]s on the Nihil-[[Second occupation of Naboo|occupied]] planet [[Naboo]] and [[Battle for Naboo|infiltrated]] Naboo's [[Theed Royal Palace|Royal Palace]]. They encountered Nihil forces led by the [[Children of the Storm|Child of the Storm]] [[Sister (Children of the Storm)|Sister]] [[H'Tar]], who then retreated to join a [[Battle of Eriadu|battle]] at the planet [[Eriadu]]. Kelnacca and Vell later also arrived at the battle with reinforcements from several factions, turning the battle against the Nihil and forcing their surrender. In the final year of Vell's training, Kelnacca and his Padawan rescued the [[Youngling|child]] [[Yesula]] and her [[Yesula's father|father]] from a [[fire]] on the astronomical object [[Veek]]. After Vell rescued their [[droid]] [[Zeekay]], Kelnacca [[Knighting Ceremony|knighted]] him and then had Vell's name [[tattoo]]ed on his head, following a tradition from Vell's [[Yarzion Vell's home planet|homeworld]]. Vell eventually took on his own Padawan, [[Ordea]], and after his death around [[149 BBY]], Kelnacca completed Ordea's [[Jedi training|training]].

In [[148 BBY]], Kelnacca was [[Mission to Brendok|stationed]] on the planet [[Brendok]] with [[Jedi Knight]] [[Sol]], Jedi Master [[Indara]], and her Padawan, [[Torbin]]. While investigating a [[vergence]] in [[the Force]] on the planet, the Jedi discovered a [[Brendok coven|coven]] of [[witch]]es led by [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Aniseya]]. After becoming concerned that the witches were training the [[Aniseya family|twins]] [[Verosha Aniseya|Verosha "Osha"]] and [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae-ho "Mae" Aniseya]] to [[Force power|use]] the Force, the Jedi requested to test the [[twin]]s to become Padawans, which Aniseya reluctantly agreed to. After seeing the unusual results of the tests, which he believed were proof of the vergence, Torbin returned to the witches' [[Brendok fortress|fortress]] against Indara's orders. The other Jedi followed, with Sol arriving first, and a skirmish broke out when he misinterpreted Aniseya's actions. Kelnacca arrived at the fortress during the fighting, but he was [[Possession|possessed]] by the witches and forced to attack his fellow Jedi until Indara broke the coven's hold on his mind. After, the Jedi departed the world with Osha, while Mae was presumed dead.

In [[132 BBY]], by which time Kelnacca was living in isolation on the planet [[Khofar]], Mae sought revenge against the [[Brendok four|four Jedi]] who had been stationed on Brendok and began [[Mae's quest|targeting]] them. After she killed Indara and Torbin, a [[Khofar Jedi task force|team]] of Jedi was [[Mission to Khofar|sent]] to Khofar to extract Kelnacca. However, Mae's master, a [[Sith]] known as [[the Stranger]], killed Kelnacca in his [[Kelnacca's shelter|shelter]] before they could reach him. Jedi Master [[Vernestra Rwoh]] later covered up the killings of Kelnacca and the other murdered Jedi by blaming their deaths on Sol, who had been [[Duel on Brendok|killed]] by Osha on Brendok.

==Biography==
===Training a Padawan===
{{Quote|Yarzion Vell, meet Master Kelnacca, part of the relief effort from Coruscant. I'm sure you're going to get on famously.|Elzar Mann, introducing Yarzion Vell to Kelnacca|<ref name="Kelnacca 1" />}}
[[File:KelnaccaMeetsYarzionVell-Kelnacca1.png|thumb|left|225px|Kelnacca meets his new Padawan, Yarzion Vell.]]
Kelnacca was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Wookiee]] [[Homeworld|from]] the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]]<ref name="Into the Light" />  who was [[Reproduction|born]] around [[380 BBY]]<ref name="Birth" /> and became a [[Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. After the [[Starlight Beacon]] [[space station]] was [[Destruction of Starlight Beacon|destroyed]]<ref name="Kelnacca 1" /> by the [[Nihil]] [[Pirate|marauders]] and crashed into the [[ocean]] of the planet [[Eiram]] in [[230 BBY]],<ref name="High Republic Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Kelnacca was sent to the crash site as part of the relief effort from<ref name="Kelnacca 1" /> the planet<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Coruscant]]. On Eiram, Jedi Master [[Elzar Mann]] introduced Kelnacca to [[Padawan]] [[Yarzion Vell]], whose master, [[Lulad]], had [[Death|died]] in the crash, so that Kelnacca could continue his [[Jedi training|training]]. After Vell thanked Kelnacca for taking him on and promised not to let him down, Kelnacca began walking away from his new Padawan, who chased after him.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" />

In [[229 BBY]],<ref name="Kelnacca 1 Flash Dates">The section of [[The Acolyte - Kelnacca 1|''The Acolyte - Kelnacca'' 1]] that takes place on [[Vianax]] occurred a [[Standard year|year]] after the [[destruction of Starlight Beacon]], which ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates to [[230 BBY]], placing the events on Vianax in [[229 BBY]]. The section of the comic that takes place on [[Coruscant]] takes place two years after the section on Vianax, equating to [[227 BBY]].</ref> Kelnacca and Vell [[Skirmish on Vianax|fought]] the Nihil on the astronomical object [[Vianax]] within the Nihil-controlled [[Occlusion Zone]]. Following the battle, the two Jedi assisted the inhabitants of a [[Unidentified settlement (Vianax)|settlement]] with repairs, with Kelnacca [[Force power|using]] [[telekinesis]] to lift debris. A group of [[Youngling|children]] watching remarked on Kelnacca's size and strength. An [[Unidentified Elomin child|Elomin child]] said that they were excited to see Kelnacca, as they had never seen a Wookiee before and he could use [[the Force]]. The group approached Vell, and a [[Unidentified human child|human child]] asked if Kelnacca ever spoke, to which Vell responded that he only did when he needed to.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" />

===Blight on Kashyyyk===
====Devastating discovery====
{{Quote|I feel like maybe—maybe a Wookiee should be the one to lead this mission. This is your planet. You have a connection to Kashyyyk I can’t duplicate.|Reath Silas and Burryaga|<ref name="Into the Light" />}}
[[File:Kashyyyk-SW-MTHC.png|thumb|right|250px|The blight was discovered on Kelnacca's homeworld of Kashyyyk.]]
In [[228 BBY]],<ref name="Into the Light Date">{{IntotheLightDate}}</ref> the [[blight]], a plague that slowly but relentlessly spread across worlds and corroded them, was found on Kashyyyk, and Kelnacca volunteered to join a [[Kashyyyk team|team]] of Jedi led by [[Jedi Knight]] [[Reath Silas]] that would embark on a [[Mission to Kashyyyk (blight)|mission]] to the planet. The team's goal on the mission was to hold back the blight through [[meditation]], study it, and to convince the native Wookiees to evacuate the planet if necessary. The Wookiee Jedi Knight [[Burryaga Agaburry|Burryaga]], who was around a [[Standard century|century]] younger than Kelnacca, introduced him to Silas after he volunteered. Due to Kelnacca's intelligence and strength in the Force, Silas was grateful that Kelnacca had joined the team. When Silas later suggested to Burryaga that a Wookiee should lead the team, Burryaga explained that the Wookiees would be too distracted by their connection to their homeworld to effectively lead.<ref name="Into the Light" />

Silas decided the team would travel to Kashyyyk on a civilian [[transport]] and hired the crew of a [[Starship|ship]] known as the ''[[Vessel]]''. Shortly before the mission, Kelnacca and Burryaga arrived at the ''Vessel''{{'s}} location on Coruscant. Kelnacca, who was even taller than Burryaga, had to duck low to get through some of the ship's passageways, and its [[captain]], [[Affie Hollow]], felt it was almost comical and mentally noted to consider putting in seats to accommodate larger [[species]]. In addition to the Jedi, the team also included [[Nan Hague]], a [[prisoner]] who claimed to have defected from the Nihil, and former Jedi Knight [[Azlin Rell]]. When Silas introduced Rell to the team, Kelnacca's [[Hair|fur]] stood on end.<ref name="Into the Light" />

====Returning home====
{{Quote|You’re right—if more people could spend time on worlds like this one, I think it would be a happier galaxy.|Reath Silas, to Kelnacca, on Kashyyyk|<ref name="Into the Light" />}}
[[File:TheVessel-CharactersTHR.png|thumb|left|350px|Kelnacca traveled to Kashyyyk aboard the ''Vessel''.]]
The ''Vessel'' departed from Coruscant soon after. As the ship had departed at night, Hollow had dimmed its lights, and Kelnacca and Burryaga slung up hammocks. The two Wookiees laid in their hammocks and growled and whined mournfully in [[Shyriiwook]]. While making her way through the ship, Hollow observed them and despite not understanding them, knew they were thinking of their wounded planet.<ref name="Into the Light" />

When the ''Vessel'' landed on Kashyyyk, Kelnacca snuffled in happiness and shared a glance of understanding with Burryaga, who reflected on the bond the Wookiees felt with their homeworld. Silas followed Burryaga off the ship onto the landing platform and looked around at the [[forest]] surrounding them. Kelnacca stood next to him and growled his pride in its beauty. Silas agreed, saying [[the galaxy]] would be happier if more people spent time on worlds like Kashyyyk. Silas then went to introduce himself to a small welcoming party of Wookiees led by the [[Elder (title)|elder]] [[Gender|matriarch]] [[Pruzzalla]], after which the group climbed down from the treetop platforms to ground level. On the ground, Jedi Master [[Belka Poiryn]], who had arrived ahead of them as part of a [[meditation team]], informed Silas she had [[Force sense|sensed]] [[Dark side of the Force|darkness]] on Kashyyyk, then guided the group to where the blight was. Upon seeing the blight, Kelnacca howled mournfully. The team then headed to a [[Pruzzalla's village|village]] to settle in.<ref name="Into the Light" />

====Drengir attack====
{{Quote|I feel I should instead join the meditation team with Burryaga and Kelnacca. Obviously the presence of the Wookiees is more critical than my own—but I strongly sense that I should support them at this time.|Cohmac Vitus, to Reath Silas|<ref name="Into the Light" />}}
[[File:TheHighRepublic-IntotheLight-TextlessCover.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kelnacca was part of a team lead by Reath Silas (pictured).]]
Early the next [[Local day|morning]], the team meditating near the blight was attacked by [[Drengir]], [[Sentience|sentient]] [[carnivorous plant]]s strong in the dark side. The Drengir were defeated, but Jedi Padawan [[Amadeo Azzazzo]] was injured. After the fighting ended, he was examined by Silas and told the Knight that he would not be able to climb back up the [[tree]]s and might have to be carried by a Wookiee. Kelnacca appeared at their sides, but Silas held up a hand, saying he wanted Azzazzo to be examined by a [[medic]] before he was moved. The Jedi and Wookiees ultimately rigged up a sling lift to transport the wounded back to the [[City|village]]. Kelnacca returned by riding a [[mylaya]] steed up the trees at almost a ninety degree angle. The [[scientist]] [[Avon Sunvale|Avon Starros]] observed Kelnacca and decided against climbing up herself, instead joining the end of the queue for the injured.<ref name="Into the Light" />

Later, Kelnacca and Burryaga both decided to join the meditation team. Silas had wanted them to join a group that would search for the Nihil scientist [[Zadina Mkampa]], but Burryaga informed Silas of their intentions. Silas was surprised, as he had not taken Kelnacca for a mystic, but Burryaga explained their strong spiritual ties to their homeworld would give their thoughts additional protective power. Silas's former master, [[Cohmac Vitus]], also told him he wanted to join the team with Kelnacca and Burryaga, although he acknowledged his presence would not be as critical as the Wookiees' would be.<ref name="Into the Light" />

====The secret of the Wookiees====
[[File:Geode-THRCharacterEncyclopedia.png|thumb|left|200px|Kelnacca and Geode (pictured) both attended the Wookiee meeting in the village.]]
After Silas's group left, it was discovered that the patch of blight had expanded, with a spike expanding eastward toward a [[White wroshyr grove|grove]] that secretly contained the last surviving [[white wroshyr tree]]s, which were considered sacred to the Wookiees. Following the discovery, Kelnacca attended a private meeting in a hut set off from the rest of the village. With the exception of [[Geode]], a [[Vintian]] who served as the [[navigator]] of the ''Vessel'', only Wookiees were invited to the meeting. Kelnacca and Burryaga both repeatedly growled their fury at [[Eye of the Nihil]] [[Marchion Ro]] and the blight, though they caught themselves and battled their tempers.<ref name="Into the Light" />

When Geode asked why they had not spoken of their secret to the Jedi, Pruzzalla's [[aide]] [[Lohgarra]] argued that non-Wookiees often profaned all they touched. Burryaga disagreed with Lohgarra, and Kelnacca added that the Jedi had arrived to provide protection, saying the white wroshyr trees were more deserving of protection than anything else on Kashyyyk. Pruzzalla decided they would have the entire village vote on the matter, and Kelnacca nodded.<ref name="Into the Light" />

As the Wookiees gathered in a large structure in the village to vote, Silas observed Kelnacca among the group. The Wookiees ultimately voted in favor of revealing the existence of the trees to the Jedi. The non-Wookiees gathered in the village, where Pruzzalla informed them of the trees. After listening to her words, Silas asked if the Wookiees would take the group there, and Pruzzalla responded that the Wookiee Jedi had asked to lead them to the grove. Following the explanation, Jedi Knight [[Dez Rydan]] realized that Kelnacca and Burryaga had already known about the secret grove. Once Pruzzalla finished speaking, Kelnacca sprang to the nearest tree and began clambering higher to arrange transportation. When Rydan saw this, he was startled at how high Kelnacca had leapt.<ref name="Into the Light" />

====The thornseed====
{{Quote|We have to get back to the white wroshyr grove, now! Burryaga, Dez, Cohmac, Kelnacca, you’re with—|Reath Silas|<ref name="Into the Light" />}}
[[File:Drengir-CGSWG.png|thumb|right|225px|Kelnacca defended the Wookiee village from the Drengir.]]
Kelnacca soon returned with mylayas for the group to use. As the team rode the steeds to the grove, Burryaga roared a yell of comradeship and shared purpose to Kelnacca. Kelnacca roared an answer that was even louder and echoed off the trees. Once the team arrived around half a [[Kilometer|klick]] away from the grove, the mylayas stopped, and Kelnacca informed Silas that they would have to make the rest of the journey on foot, as the mylayas could sense the white wroshyr trees and instinctively kept their distance from the larger life-forms. While they walked, Hollow thought about a warning Lohgarra had given the group about dangerous life-forms in the forest, but felt that because Kelnacca and Burryaga did not seem worried, she did not have to be either. Once the group reached the grove, they discovered a [[thornseed]], a type of [[Sith artifact]] capable of turning the [[plant]] life in an area to the dark side, in the [[Well of Night]], a hole within the grove. After discussing the thornseed, the team returned to the village.<ref name="Into the Light" />

The next [[Standard day|day]], the Drengir attacked the village. During the fighting, Kelnacca bellowed while brutally cuffing a Drengir, knocking it to the forest floor. After repelling the attack, Starros and Silas realized the Drengir had been influenced into attacking the village by Mkampa to distract them from the thornseed. Silas shouted for Kelnacca and several other Jedi to join him in returning to the white wroshyr grove. Hollow arrived in the ''Vessel'' and descended to allow the team to board it so they could return to the grove. The group gathered on a [[rope]] bridge to leap to the ''Vessel'', and Nan made her way to the crowd and grabbed Kelnacca's [[Limb|arm]]. Without looking at who he was assisting or feeling her weight, Kelnacca leapt into the ship.<ref name="Into the Light" />

====Battle in the grove====
[[File:Kelnacca-Kelnacca1PhotoCover.png|thumb|200px|left|Kelnacca wielded his green-bladed lightsaber against the Drengir.]]
Near the grove, Mkampa attacked the group in her [[Spider Cruiser|Spider Squall]] ''[[Firebringer]]'' and summoned the Drengir using [[light intensifier]]s aimed at the thornseed. At a point during the battle, Kelnacca held off two Drengir at once with his lightsaber. The Jedi and Wookiees were outnumbered and overwhelmed by the Drengir, so Silas called for them to retreat across a bridge to the island the grove was located on. The Drengir began to gather near the bridge, but the influence of the white wroshyr trees temporarily kept them from reaching the island. When Silas picked up Nan, who had been hurt during the fight, Kelnacca came up beside them and roared at Silas that he should not strain his [[human]] muscles with the burden. He grabbed Nan by the collar of her [[Clothing|shirt]] and plopped her across his shoulder.<ref name="Into the Light" />

The group made attempts to destroy the thornseed, but were unable to do so. After one attempt, Kelnacca roared to warn the team that the Drengir were coming. He dumped Nan, who was semiconscious, into a nearby bush, then attacked the Drengir with his lightsaber as they stormed into the grove. Kelnacca ripped a Drengir in two and bellowed his victory over it. Despite defeating several of the Drengir, the Jedi and their allies were still overwhelmed. To save them, Geode [[Temperature|heated]] himself to superconductivity, then exploded, sacrificing himself to destroy the thornseed. With the thornseed destroyed, the Drengir were deprived of some of their power and slowed, though they did not cease their attack.<ref name="Into the Light" />

====Communing with the trees====
{{Quote|Burryaga, Kelnacca, I hereby promise you that neither I nor anyone else on this mission will breathe one word about this grove, not even to the Jedi Council, unless you and the other Wookiees decide that we should.|Reath Silas, to Kelnacca and Burryaga|<ref name="Into the Light" />}}
[[File:Burryaga-DatabankPhaseIII.png|thumb|right|250px|Kelnacca worked with Burryaga (pictured) to commune with the white wroshyr trees.]]
Burryaga leapt into the Well of Night to commune with the white wroshyr trees, and Kelnacca followed him in. His fearsome grin was replaced with an expression of humility, as communing with the trees was considered one of the riskiest and holiest acts possible for a Wookiee. The two Wookiees stood face to face with their [[eye]]s closed and remained deep in meditation as the trees began to radiate pure light. The white wroshyr trees communicated with the Drengir and their leader, the [[Great Progenitor]], and convinced them to turn to the [[light side of the Force]].<ref name="Into the Light" />

Following the Drengir's conversion, Silas promised Kelnacca and Burryaga that he and the other members of the team would not speak of the white wroshyr grove to anyone else, even to the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]], unless the Wookiees permitted it. Kelnacca gruffly responded that he thought it was unlikely they would decide to do so. He stated the grove was a Wookiee secret and should remain one, but he trusted both the Jedi and civilian members of the team to not speak of it. Soon after, Mkampa was arrested, and a service was held for Geode at sunset.<ref name="Into the Light" />

The group returned to the village, where they learned from Pruzzalla that the blight had vanished and the damaged caused by it had been healed when the white wroshyr trees's power had been released from restraining the thornseed. A party was later held in the village, and Kelnacca was one of the chief percussionists. He stood at the head of the drummers and banged on an enormous [[drum]]. Several Jedi, including Azzazzo, and at least two dozen Wookiees danced to the drummers' deep percussive beat. The Jedi remained on Kashyyyk for at least one additional day following the end of the [[Drengir crisis]].<ref name="Into the Light" />

===Battling the Nihil===
====Infiltration on Naboo====
{{Dialogue|Kelnacca|Rrruuuhraaaaa.|Lourna Dee|Then our objectives may very much align, good-looking. Need a hand breaking into the Nihil stronghold?|Yarzion Vell|You're proposing an alliance?|Lourna Dee|You help us find Sister H'Tar, and we'll help you liberate the planet.|attr=Kelnacca, Lourna Dee, and Yarzion Vell discuss an alliance|src=<ref name="Fear of the Jedi 1">[[The High Republic – Fear of the Jedi 1|''The High Republic – Fear of the Jedi'' 1]]</ref>}}
[[File:KelnaccaYarzion-THRFOTJ1.png|thumb|left|275px|Kelnacca and Vell on Naboo]]
Later that [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Fear of the Jedi Date">The events of [[The High Republic – Fear of the Jedi 1|''The High Republic – Fear of the Jedi'' 1]] are set between the events of ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Dispatches from the Occlusion Zone]]'' and [[The High Republic – Fear of the Jedi 2|''The High Republic – Fear of the Jedi'' 2]] which includes the [[Battle of Eriadu]]. ''Dispatches from the Occlusion Zone'' and the Battle of Eriadu are both dated to [[228 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:THRContent228BBY|here]].</ref> Kelnacca and Vell were present on the Nihil-[[Second occupation of Naboo|occupied]] planet [[Naboo]] when they witnessed a [[Battle for Naboo|confrontation]] between a group of the marauders and three members of the [[Tempest Breakers]] [[bounty hunter]]'s guild—[[Lourna Dee]], [[Quin Carree]], and [[Tey Sirrek]]. Dee shot at a [[Unidentified Gloovan Nihil|Gloovan Nihil]], but Vell leapt and deflected her shot with his lightsaber, instead pushing the [[Gloovan]] away with the Force. The two other Nihil were surprised to see Jedi on Naboo, and Kelnacca [[mind trick]]ed them into [[stun]]ning each other with their [[blaster]]s. The Jedi introduced themselves, and Dee responded she had heard from Mann that he believed there were still Jedi alive on Naboo.<ref name="Fear of the Jedi 1" />

Quin informed the Jedi that they were looking for survivors of experiments conducted by the Nihil scientist [[Baron]] [[Boolan]], and Kelnacca responded in Shyriiwook. Dee proposed an alliance, offering to help them break into the Nihil stronghold on Naboo and liberate the planet if the Jedi assisted them with locating [[Sister (Children of the Storm)|Sister]] [[H'Tar]], one of Boolan's [[Children of the Storm]]<ref name="Fear of the Jedi 1" /> [[Jedi hunter]]s.<ref name="Tears of the Nameless">''[[The High Republic: Tears of the Nameless]]''</ref> Kelnacca questioned her, and Dee claimed that she was motivated by [[Currency|money]] rather than helping out of the goodness of her heart.<ref name="Fear of the Jedi 1" />

The group infiltrated Naboo's [[Theed Royal Palace|Royal Palace]], with Kelnacca overriding a lock within the building. Quin complained to Dee that she allowed Kelnacca to override the lock instead of letting<ref name="Fear of the Jedi 1" /> her<ref name="Tempest Runner">''[[The High Republic: Tempest Runner]]''</ref> do it, but Dee responded that it was sometimes better to let the Wookiee [[Slicer|slice]]. Quin apologized, and both she and Dee noted they had feelings of unease. Vell compared the feeling to that caused by the<ref name="Fear of the Jedi 1" /> [[Living Force|Force]]-[[Diet|consuming]]<ref name="High Republic Character Encyclopedia" /> [[Shrikarai|Nameless]] creatures and asked Kelnacca if he believed any were present, but Kelnacca disagreed, and Dee noted that the Nameless would not affect her. ===A sign of respect===
{{Quote|I'm sorry, Master. I know it was only a droid, but what the child said about the holos of her mother…|Yarzion Vell, to Kelnacca|<ref name="Kelnacca 1" />}}
[[File:YarzionTattoosKelnacca-Kelnacca1.png|thumb|right|240px|Kelnacca had Vell's name tattooed on his head.]]

He further explained that after Vell had gotten Lulad's name tattooed on his head, Lulad had decided to be tattooed with Vell's name, as she believed a Jedi's greatest lessons came from those they taught. Kelnacca did not respond to what Vell had told him, but Vell knew he did not need to.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" />

In the final year of Vell's training, Kelnacca and Vell assisted the child [[Yesula]] and her [[Yesula's father|father]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] astronomical object [[Veek]], where their home had caught [[fire]]. Vell subsequently apologized to Kelnacca for rescuing the droid, but Kelnacca responded by igniting his [[Kelnacca's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and cutting Vell's [[Padawan braid]], [[Knighting Ceremony|knighting]] him. Kelnacca then asked to be tattooed with Vell's name in the same way that Lulad had. Vell agreed to the request and applied the tattoo.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" />

===Mission to Brendok===
====Investigating a vergence====
{{Quote|It's unwise to insult a Wookiee's cooking.|Indara, to Torbin|<ref name="Choice">{{Acolyte|Choice}}</ref>}}
[[File:ChefKelnacca-Choice.png|thumb|right|270px|Kelnacca served as cook during the mission to Brendok.]]
In 148 BBY,<ref name="Death Date" /> Kelnacca was [[Mission to Brendok|stationed]] on the planet [[Brendok]] with Jedi Knight [[Sol]], Indara, and her Padawan, Torbin.<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> The group was known as the [[Brendok four]].<ref name="Challenges" /> The Jedi investigated the life present on Brendok, as it was thriving despite being catalogued as lifeless after a [[Great Hyperspace Disaster|hyperspace disaster]]<ref name="Choice" /> in [[232 BBY]].<ref name="High Republic Character Encyclopedia" /> On a day seven [[Standard week|weeks]] into the mission, Kelnacca used<ref name="Choice" /> a [[soil sampler]] and a [[terrain scanner]]<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> as part of the investigation. That night, Kelnacca cooked [[nuna]] legs for the group,<ref name="Choice" /> to which he added [[calarantrum root]] seasoning to compensate for freeze-related blandness.<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> Torbin complained he was tired of eating nuna legs, and Indara warned him not to insult a Wookiee's cooking. Sol and Indara went on to explain to Torbin that they were searching Brendok for a [[vergence]], a concentration of Force energy around a location.<ref name="Choice" />

The next day, Kelnacca continued using his [[Sensor|scanner]]. While apart from the rest of the group, Sol discovered a [[Brendok coven|coven]] of [[witch]]es led by [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Aniseya]]. He learned of the [[twin]]s [[Verosha Aniseya|Verosha "Osha"]] and [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae-ho "Mae" Aniseya]]—who were the daughters of Aniseya and Mother [[Koril]]—and became concerned the children were being trained to use the Force, known to the witches as the Thread. After Sol reported this to the other Jedi, they rode [[Jedi outland speeder bike|speeder bikes]] to the coven's [[Brendok fortress|fortress]], and Kelnacca sliced the controls to an [[Turbolift|elevator]] to grant the group access.<ref name="Choice" />

====Disrupting the ascension====
{{Quote|I am Master Indara, and these are my colleagues, Sol, Kelnacca, and my Padawan, Torbin.|Indara introducing the Jedi to the Brendok Coven|<ref name="Choice" />}}
[[File:JediOnBrendok-Destiny.png|thumb|left|300px|Kelnacca and the rest of the Brendok four in the coven's fortress]]
The Jedi entered the [[Rite of Ascension courtyard|courtyard]] where the twins' [[Rite of Ascension]] ceremony, in which they would become witches, was being held. Indara introduced the four Jedi and stated their concerns about the witches training children against [[Galactic Republic]] law. The witches refuted Indara's claims, stating that Brendok was not part of the Republic and that they had no children. However, Kelnacca noticed the twins in the crowd of witches, and Indara asked them to come out. When Sol suggested that Osha be tested to train as a Jedi, she asked her mother for permission. In response, Aniseya incapacitated Torbin with a Thread ability and threatened to not reverse its effects unless the Jedi left. However,<ref name="Episode III">{{Acolyte|Destiny (The Acolyte)}}</ref> she<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> released Torbin and reluctantly agreed to allow her children to be tested after Osha and Indara persuaded her. Following this, the Jedi exited the courtyard.<ref name="Episode III" />

The next day, when Osha and Mae arrived at the site of the Jedi's starship,<ref name="Choice" /> a [[Polan-717 Jedi transport|Polan shuttle]] designated [[Polan GX-8|GX-8]],<ref name="Starfighters">[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]]</ref> Kelnacca was repairing a damaged [[speeder bike]]. While waiting for Mae to finish her testing, Osha approached Kelnacca, and he briefly spoke with her in Shyriiwook before she entered the Polan. When she exited after completing her testing, Kelnacca was performing other mechanical work. He noticed her and called out to her in Shyriiwook. In response, Osha<ref name="Choice" /> half-heartedly<ref name="Choice AD">{{Acolyte|Choice}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> smiled at him.<ref name="Choice" /> 

====Confronting the coven====
{{Quote|Go. We must stop him before he starts a conflict. Go!|Indara, to Kelnacca|<ref name="Choice" />}}
[[File:SolvsKelnacca-Choice.png|thumb|right|300px|Kelnacca attacked Sol and Torbin while under the coven's influence.]]
That night, the group discussed the [[Jedi Council]]'s refusal to allow them to bring the twins to Coruscant. When Torbin reported the results of the twins' [[Midi-chlorian|M-count]] test, Kelnacca gathered around him with Indara and Sol. After realizing the unusual results indicated the possibility of the vergence the Jedi had been seeking,<ref name="Choice" /> something that frightened all gathered,<ref name="In231">{{InsiderCite|231|A Certain Point of View}}</ref> Torbin, against his master's orders, took a speeder bike and headed to the fortress. Indara ordered Sol to pursue him on another bike, while she and Kelnacca followed on the Polan. As they approached, Indara was unable to land and so got close enough for Kelnacca to jump, telling him to stop Torbin before he started a conflict.<ref name="Choice" />

Inside the fortress, Sol and Torbin confronted the witches, and a fight broke out after Sol killed Aniseya. Kelnacca arrived during the fight, but he was [[Possession|possessed]] by the witches,<ref name="Choice" /> who had united to ensorcell his mind and turn him into a raging berserker, forcing him to attack his fellow Jedi.<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> He engaged them in a [[lightsaber duel]], first attacking Torbin and then Sol. Kelnacca then turned his attention to Torbin again, leaping high into the air toward him and knocking him to the ground. Kelnacca threw Sol to the ground as well, then pushed both Jedi back with the Force. Torbin blocked more attacks from Kelnacca while crawling away from him, and the Wookiee picked up Torbin and slammed him into a wall, blinding his left eye. Torbin blocked another strike from Kelnacca while the Wookiee held him against the wall, and Sol was able to pull Kelnacca away. Kelnacca and Sol continued to duel, with Sol disarming Kelnacca and fighting him in [[Unarmed combat|hand-to-hand combat]].<ref name="Choice" /> 

As Kelnacca attempted to strangle Sol, Indara arrived and tackled Kelnacca to the ground. She was able to free him from the witches's power,<ref name="Choice" /> with the psychic whiplash wiping out the entire coven.<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> Indara then ordered Sol to save the twins from a fire Mae had started, but<ref name="Choice" /> he<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> was only able to rescue Osha, with Mae being presumed dead. After, Kelnacca and the other Jedi returned to Coruscant on their ship.<ref name="Choice" /> Following the incident, Osha became Sol's Padawan, although she later left the Order.<ref name="Episode I">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> As a result of the mission's events, Kelnacca became obsessed with the symbol of the Ascension ceremony, which clouded his mind for years.<ref name="Acolyte VG" />

===Assignment on Khofar===
====Exile====
{{Quote|I can get us out of this city.''"<br />"''And go where?''"<br />"''Khofar.''"<br />"''What the hell is Khofar?''"<br />"''A relaxing forest retreat in the Outer Rim where the Wookiee Jedi lives.|Qimir and Mae Aniseya|<ref name="Episode II">{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}}</ref>}}
[[File:Kelnacca-RevengeJustice.png|thumb|left|300px|Kelnacca discovers trespassers to his shelter in the jungles of Khofar.]]
Around [[137 BBY]],<ref name="Posted">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' establishes that Kelnacca was 149 [[Standard year|years]] old at the time of the [[destruction of Starlight Beacon]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[230 BBY]]. ''The Acolyte: The Visual Guide'' establishes Kelnacca was assigned to [[Khofar]] at the age of 243, equating to around [[137 BBY]], and that he ventured deeper into Khofar's [[forest]]s at age 247, equating to around [[133 BBY]].</ref> the Jedi Council assigned Kelnacca to the Outer Rim planet [[Khofar]]. He welcomed the posting, as he had found Coruscant stifling and the forested planet was similar to Kashyyyk. Kelnacca used the assignment as a time of exile and penance.<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> Around [[133 BBY]],<ref name="Posted" /> Kelnacca ventured deeper into Khofar's forests, drawn by the allure of the wilderness and a desire to leave the past behind. He lost contact with the Jedi and lived in a [[Kelnacca's shelter|shelter]] made from a wrecked [[astrotreadable]] wrapped around a tree, where he lived off the land. He posted a sign with [[writing]] in [[Wookiee script|Shyriiwook]] near his shelter warning trespassers to keep away.<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> Kelnacca kept himself isolated from civilization and scrawled the symbol of the Ascension ceremony on every open surface within his shelter.<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|kelnacca|Kelnacca}}</ref> 

Sixteen years after the mission to Brendok,<ref name="Episode II" /> in [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Death Date" /> Mae began targeting the four Jedi who had been stationed on Brendok, both to seek revenge and to please her master,<ref name="Episode II" /> a [[Sith]] known as [[the Stranger]], who additionally tasked Mae with killing one of the Jedi without a [[weapon]].<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> After [[Indara's murder|killing]] Indara, Mae requested a [[poison]] to use on Torbin from her supplier Qimir,<ref name="Episode II" /> who, unbeknownst to Mae, was secretly her master.<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> Qimir expressed doubts about her ability to kill Kelnacca, as she had already previously failed to kill Torbin while he was meditating. Mae was later able to kill Torbin by offering him the poison. Shortly after, Osha, who was assisting the investigation into the murders, told Sol that Mae was targeting Kelnacca and the other Jedi stationed on Brendok. Later, Qimir informed Mae that he had located Kelnacca on Khofar.<ref name="Episode II" />

On Khofar, Kelnacca encountered the [[scavenger]]s<ref name="Episode II" /> [[Meevid]] and [[Manju]]<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> outside his shelter. When Meevid drew a blaster, Kelnacca pulled the weapon to himself with the Force and broke it in two with his hands. In response, the two scavengers fled.<ref name="Episode II" /> Sometime later, Kelnacca again returned to his shelter with some plants, which he used to prepare a meal.<ref name="Episode IV">{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}}</ref>

====Death====
{{Quote|Master Holden, extract Kelnacca from his post on Khofar and intercept Mae.|Vernestra Rwoh|<ref name="Episode IV" /> }}
In the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, a small council was convened by Jedi Master [[Vernestra Rwoh]] to discuss Mae's murders. Holograms of Kelnacca, Torbin, and Indara were displayed, with the two Jedi who had been killed being displayed in [[Color|red]]. Rwoh ordered Jedi Master [[Veo Holden]] to extract Kelnacca from his post on Khofar and to bring in Mae. Later, Sol convinced Rwoh to allow him to bring Osha with them to Khofar. Mae and Qimir, who had landed on Khofar, began searching for Kelnacca. While they walked, they discussed how Mae's previous murders had not pleased her master and that she would have to kill Kelnacca without a weapon.<ref name="Episode IV" /> 

[[File:KelnaccaDead-Day.png|thumb|right|300px|Mae discovered Kelnacca's body after he was killed by the Stranger.]]
In [[hyperspace]] on the way to Khofar, Jedi Knight [[Yord Fandar]] briefed the team on the [[Mission to Khofar|mission]]. The Knight informed the team Kelnacca had not been heard from in over a year and had not responded to any of the warnings sent to him by the Jedi. After landing, Padawan [[Jecki Lon]] spoke with a [[Wiltoo Kajok|local]] and learned that Kelnacca had ventured into the forest and never returned. Fandar provided the [[Tynnan]] tracker [[Bazil]] with a cloth, which he used to track Kelnacca. The others followed Bazil through the forest toward Kelnacca. Meanwhile, Mae had decided to stop her killings and set a trap for Qimir. After he triggered it, she informed him she planned to surrender herself to Kelnacca and left him hanging from a tree. Before she arrived, however, Kelnacca was killed in his shelter by the Stranger. When Mae arrived outside Kelnacca's shelter, she encountered Bazil, who alerted the Jedi team to her presence. She ran and entered the shelter, where she found Kelnacca's body.<ref name="Episode IV" /> Mae cowered next to him while realizing her master was aware of her failure and disloyalty.<ref name="Acolyte VG" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|But does he ever say anything?''"<br />"''Oh, he says things. But only when he ''really'' needs to.|A human child asks Yarzion Vell about Kelnacca|<ref name="Kelnacca 1" />}}
[[File:Kelnacca-TheAcolyte.png|thumb|250px|right|Kelnacca had a towering and noble presence.]]
Kelnacca was a Wookiee with gray eyes and brown, unkempt fur that was prone to knotting. By the time of the mission to Brendok, Kelnacca's fur had lightened due to solar exposure from exotic [[Star|suns]].<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> He wore his lighter brown head fur in a topknot<ref name="Into the Light" /> in homage to a past student, and his shorn scalp revealed<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> tattoos on the top of his head, which had Vell's name written in runes in the [[Unidentified language (Yarzion Vell)|language]] of his ancestors.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" /> Kelnacca stood 2.29 [[meter]]s (seven [[Foot|feet]], six inches) tall.<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> Kelnacca only spoke when necessary and often remained silent. Yarzion Vell considered him to be brave and powerful.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" /> Reath Silas considered Kelnacca to be reserved and gruff compared to Buryaga, but also intelligent.<ref name="Into the Light" /> He was also stoic and wise.<ref name="ComicReveal">{{WebCite|url=https://gizmodo.com/wookiee-jedi-star-wars-comic-acolyte-marvel-kelnacca-1851509251|text=''Star Wars''{{'}} New Wookiee Jedi Is Getting His Own Marvel Comic|author=Lussier, Germain|date=2024-05-31|work=[[Wikipedia:Gizmodo|''Gizmodo'']]|archivedate=20240531163410}}</ref> In battle, Kelnacca usually had wild eyes and a fearsome toothy grin.<ref name="Into the Light" /> Lourna Dee described him as "good-looking."<ref name="Fear of the Jedi 1" />

Kelnacca had a towering and noble presence that exuded confidence and control. As a Wookiee, he had a lifespan of several centuries, which he devoted to studying the Force and his duties as a Jedi. He was aware of his physical power and also knew the value of serenity. Although Wookiees had a reputation for short tempers, Kelnacca had an expertly honed mastery of his deepest instincts.<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> Although he was furious at Marchion Ro and the blight when it was found on Kashyyyk, he caught himself and battled his temper.<ref name="Into the Light" /> Kelnacca spoke Shyriiwook and could understand [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]], though he could not speak it. Despite this, Kelnacca and other Jedi were drawn closer together by the connection of the Force. Kelnacca felt a kinship with Indara that drew him out of his reclusive shell. During the Brendok mission, Indara believed that only she and Kelnacca were properly focused.<ref name="Acolyte VG" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|If you think a sleeping monk is tough, good luck defeating a Wookiee.|Qimir, to Mae Aniseya|<ref name="Episode II" />}}
[[File:KelnaccaForcePush-Choice.png|thumb|left|350px|Kelnacca Force pushes Torbin and Sol.]]
A rare example of a Wookiee Jedi Master,<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> Kelnacca was strong in the Force.<ref name="Into the Light" /> He used the Force to help move debris and to protect others from a fire.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" /> He used a mind trick to have two members of the Nihil stun each other.<ref name="Fear of the Jedi 1" /> Kelnacca also used the Force to pull a blaster from a scavenger. He was physically strong enough to break the blaster in two with his bare hands,<ref name="Episode II" /> as well as to kick a hole in a stone wall.<ref name="Choice" /> He was unable to prevent the Brendok coven from possessing him and turning him against his fellow Jedi. While being controlled by the Brendok coven, he was initially able to dominate Sol and Torbin in melee combat with his lightsaber, physical strength, and Force pushes.<ref name="Choice" />

Kelnacca was able to slice doors<ref name="Choice" /> and perform mechanical work.<ref name="Episode III" /> He was an accomplished cook who could prepare meals fit for humans.<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> He cooked [[Foodstuff|food]] for the other Jedi on Brendok,<ref name="Choice" /> as well as for himself on Khofar.<ref name="Episode III" /> Kelnacca was capable of playing a drum and served as one of the chief percussionists during the celebration on Kashyyyk.<ref name="Into the Light" />

Kelnacca was familiar with the Wrruushi fighting discipline and taught it to Indara. He had a well-honed physique, which paired powerfully with Jedi disciplines. Kelnacca developed his leg strength, which allowed him to cover long distances and leap incredible spans while traversing Khofar, and also lent great power to his strikes. His stance could intimidate combatants into surrendering. High speeds could reduce his sense of smell.<ref name="Acolyte VG" />

==Equipment==
Kelnacca wielded a green-bladed lightsaber that had distinct wear from many years of use<ref name="Saber DB">{{Databank|kelnacca-s-lightsaber|Kelnacca's lightsaber}}</ref> and a lengthened grip to accommodate Wookiee hands.<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> He wore brown and gold [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]].<ref name="Choice" /> On Brendok, Kelnacca used a terrain scanner and a soil sampler while investigating the possibility of a vergence.<ref name="Choice" /> On Khofar, he wore a traditional Wookiee satchel received from a Kashyyyk elder in which he stored food prep items, including wrapped nutritional ingredients and<ref name="Acolyte VG" /> and plants.<ref name="Episode II" /> Kelnacca also used horticultural snippers with well maintained shear blades.<ref name="Acolyte VG" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Creator comments===
{{Quote|Kelnacca is a very proud Jedi. He's obviously completed his Jedi training, but I thought he always felt as a bit of an outsider because, obviously, he's not human-born. So that caused me to think that he's a bit of a lone wolf sort of thing. So he's with the others, but he's also mindful that he might not a hundred percent belong with the other Jedi in that way.|Joonas Suotamo|<ref name="Entertainment Reacts">{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/the-acolyte-kelnacca-joonas-suotamo-reacts-wookiee-jedi-reveal-exclusive-8663693|text=''The Acolyte'' star Joonas Suotamo reacts to shocking Kelnacca reveal|archivedate=20241224151308}}</ref>}}
[[File:Kelnacca-LeslyeHeadland-EW.png|thumb|right|300px|Leslye Headland introducing Kelnacca at ''Star Wars'' Celebration Europe 2023]]
Kelnacca first appeared in "[[Revenge / Justice]]," the second episode of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'',<ref name="Episode II" /> which aired on [[June 4]], 2024.<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> Kelnacca was portrayed by [[Joonas Suotamo]]. The character was first revealed at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|''Star Wars'' Celebration Europe]] on [[April 7]], [[2023]]. At Celebration, Kelnacca was introduced on stage by showrunner [[Leslye Headland]] at the [[Lucasfilm]] Studio Showcase,<ref name="Showcase">{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-lucasfilm-studio-showcase|text=SWCE 2023: 11 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase|author=[[Dan Brooks|Brooks, Dan]]|date=2023-04-08}}</ref> appeared in a Celebration-exclusive trailer,<ref name="CelebrationTrailer">{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}}</ref> and was discussed in a live-streamed interview with Suotamo.<ref name="Celebration Day 1">{{SWYouTube|VyIHhK2VKvQ|Star Wars Celebration LIVE! 2023 - DAY 1}}</ref> On [[May 29]], 2024, items based on characters from ''The Acolyte'', including hairstyle and beard customizations inspired by Kelnacca, were added to the [[Electronic Arts]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20240528-0|text=Items inspired by ''Star Wars™'': The Acolyte will be coming to SWTOR!}}</ref>

At first, Headland did not think she would be allowed to have a Wookiee Jedi in ''The Acolyte'', but she kept pitching the idea, which was loved by special effects artist [[Neal Scanlan]]. One reason Headland said she pushed for the concept was because she could not resist the opportunity to be on set with a Wookiee. Headland's wife, [[Rebecca Henderson]],<ref name="Entertainment">{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/tv/the-acolyte-star-wars-wookiee-jedi-kelnacca-joonas-suotamo|text=How ''The Acolyte'' brought the Wookiee Jedi Kelnacca to life on screen|archivedate=20240220013555}}</ref> who portrayed Vernestra Rwoh,<ref name="Introducing the Cast" /> was scared of Kelnacca, which Headland thought was funny.<ref name="Entertainment" /> Headland believed that Kelnacca was the only Jedi who was blameless in the events that occurred on Brendok, saying he deserved a "pass," but she did not think he would give himself one. According to Headland, Kelnacca did not forgive himself for the incident, which was part of the reason he went into isolation.<ref name="Interview">{{YouTube|video=QlGqaQG1F2M|text=Leslye Headland Answers our Acolyte Questions and Teases for the Finale!|name=Star Wars Explained|date=2024-7-15}}</ref>

At Celebration, Suotamo expressed his excitement about playing a Jedi, saying he had wanted to be one since he was a kid. He was fascinated by the concept of a Wookiee Jedi and said he knew fans would be as well.<ref name="Celebration Day 1" /> Suotamo said that although it was up to interpretation, he believed Kelnacca fought back against his attacker before being killed. He also believed that Kelnacca felt like an outsider and did not completely belong with other Jedi. Suotamo thought that because Kelnacca was an outsider, it made his choice to go into seclusion easier. Headland did not tell Suotamo about Kelnacca's fate when she first explained the role to him. Suotamo was surprised when he later learned of his death, but he felt that it was necessary for the story and was both sad and dramatic.<ref name="Entertainment Reacts" /> 

===Portrayal===
{{Quote|He was sort of like a samurai master, but also being of imposing size, that sort of led me to believe that he's like the Mufasa of Star Wars—that he's walking there and a very, very imposing figure for the others.|Joonas Suotamo|<ref name="Entertainment Reacts" />}}
Suotamo, who had previously played the Wookiee [[Chewbacca]] in the [[sequel trilogy]] and<ref name="Kaos">{{InsiderCite|230|Kelnacca Kaos}}</ref> the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film<ref name="Solo">{{SW|url=news/solo-a-star-wars-story-is-here|text=''Solo: A Star Wars Story'' Is Here!}}</ref> ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Kaos" /> deliberately tried to differentiate his performance as Kelnacca from Chewbacca, as even though both characters are Wookiees, he felt they were very different. He said that there was more to being a Jedi and that it was a challenge. Suotamo enjoyed preparing and training for his role with his castmates and said they had a lot of time to think about each situation and moment.<ref name="Entertainment" /> While filming<ref name="Entertainment Reacts" /> the [[2017]] sequel trilogy film<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi]]'',<ref name="Entertainment Reacts" /> director<ref name="TLJ" /> [[Rian Johnson]] recommended Suotamo study the [[Wikipedia:Silent film|silent film]] actors [[Wikipedia:Charlie Chaplin|Charlie Chaplin]] and [[Wikipedia:Buster Keaton|Buster Keaton]] to learn how to show what his character was thinking. Suotamo tried to use what he learned from that while portraying Kelnacca.<ref name="Entertainment Reacts" />

[[File:Joonas_Suotamo.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Kelnacca was portrayed by actor Joonas Suotamo.]]
Although other Wookiee Jedi, such as Burryaga, have appeared in High Republic era media, Kelnacca was the first to appear in live-action. Headland said she thought it would be "cool" to do her own version of a Wookiee Jedi. She was also inspired by Suotamo's performance as Chewbacca in ''Solo,'' saying that she wanted to see him do fighting and action work as a Jedi and not just be a sidekick.<ref name="Entertainment" />

Suotamo was excited to test himself and see the lengths he could go to in his role. He considered how Kelnacca behaved, how he carried himself, and what he learned during his time [[Jedi Training|training]] as a Jedi while preparing for his role.<ref name="Introducing the Cast">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-cast-interview|text=Introducing the Cast of ''The Acolyte''}}</ref> Suotamo explained that while both Chewbacca and Kelnacca were devoted and loyal, as well as relaxed, Kelnacca had a sense of duty to the Jedi way that Chewbacca did not.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" /> He also described Kelnacca as proud<ref name="Entertainment Reacts" /> and a noble being who tried to walk a certain way and keep himself centered.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" /> Suotamo compared Kelnacca to a [[Wikipedia:Samurai|samurai]] master<ref name="Entertainment Reacts" /> and also channeled the character [[Wikipedia:Mufasa|Mufasa]] from<ref name="Kelnacca 1" /> the [[1994]] animated film<ref name="Lion King">{{Disney|subdomain=movies|url=the-lion-king|text=The Lion King}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:The Lion King|''The Lion King'']] to strike a balance between esteemed Jedi grandeur and natural ferocity.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" />

===Development===
{{Quote|Unfortunately not everything gets to be included for budget and story reasons, we had an early draft that showed his fight and death scene but it ultimately broke the POV of the episode in a way that I think wouldn't have worked as well.|Clare Kiechel|<ref name="Clare Kiechel Tweet">{{Twitter|clairekiechel|status/1803312316026335536|[[Claire Kiechel]]|date2024-06-19|quote=Unfortunately not everything gets to be included for budget and story reasons, we had an early draft that showed his fight and death scene but it ultimately broke the POV of the episode in a way that I think wouldn't have worked as well.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/RfKJH|archivefile=File:ClaireKiechel-KelnaccaDeath.png|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
[[File:KelnaccaTowerDuelConcept-ArtOfAcolyte.png|thumb|right|250px|Concept art by Adam Brockbank of Kelnacca's tower]]
In early versions of the story, Kelnacca was hiding on Kashyyyk, the Wookiee homeworld. It was changed to Khofar in order to explore new areas of the [[galaxy]].<ref name="Episode IV Guide Slide 2">{{SW|url=day-trivia-gallery-the-acolyte|text="Day" Trivia Gallery | The Acolyte}} {{C|Slide 2}}</ref> Kelnacca's shelter was originally a radio tower he was building, but according to production designer [[Kevin Jenkins]], it was changed because he was in exile and would not be building a home. One concept art piece by [[Adam Brockbank]] showed Mae and Osha dueling on the foot of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport|AT-AT]] that made up Kelnacca's tower, which Headland considered to be a forgotten thing that fit with Kelnacca's character and the idea of a buried past.<ref name="Art of Acolyte">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''</ref> An early draft for<ref name="Clare Kiechel Tweet" /> "[[Day (episode)|Day]]"<ref name="Episode IV" /> the fourth episode of the series, which aired on [[June 18]], 2024,<ref name="Episode IV Guide">{{SW|url=series/the-acolyte/season-1-episode-4-day-episode-guide|text="Day" Episode Guide | The Acolyte}}</ref> was going to show Kelnacca's fight against the Stranger and his death scene, but this was changed due to budgetary issues and story problems, such as the scene breaking the episode's [[Wikipedia:Point of view|point of view]] in a way writer [[Claire Kiechel]] felt to not work well.<ref name="Clare Kiechel Tweet" />

For the show's original characters,<ref name="Lightsaber color">{{OfficialYouTube|channel=@RottenTomatoesTV|name=Rotten Tomatoes|link=Wikipedia:Rotten Tomatoes|video=hkJos35CuV0|text='The Acolyte' Cast on New Lightsabers and Droids|date=2024-05-30}}</ref> which included Kelnacca,<ref name="Episode II" /> Headland personally selected the color of their lightsabers based on the character's personality and the aesthetics of the scenes they appeared in.<ref name="Lightsaber color" /> Kelnacca's lightsaber was originally made too short and was difficult to see under his hairy hand. The final version of his hilt was bigger and also took into account the long lifespan of Wookiees by showing the copper under its usual finish. Prop manufacturer [[Jim McKeown]] felt that the color of the copper worked well with the character. Lightsabers used by characters in ''The Acolyte'', including Kelnacca, had lucite hilts and embedded LED lights created by [[Joshua Polley]]'s prop department and McKeown's prop manufacturing team.<ref name="Art of Acolyte" />

===Design===
{{Quote|Obviously, they do have a Wookiee Jedi in the High Republic, and we thought it would be cool to do our own version of that. He has a very different character design.|Leslye Headland|<ref name="Entertainment" />}}
Like other characters in ''The Acolyte,'' Kelnacca came from his design first. Headland loved the idea of a Wookiee with the sides of his head shaved, which was the design that became Kelnacca. Although he was partially inspired by other Wookiee Jedi such as Burryaga, Kelnacca's character design was made to be different from Burryaga.<ref name="Entertainment" /> Neal Scanlan and his team, who had previously worked on Chewbacca, also worked on Kelnacca. Because he is a Jedi, they gave Kelnacca a more stately appearance, as well as more refined features to allow for more emotional responses. He was designed to be more refined than previous Wookiees. Kelnacca was also given a more articulate mouth and discreet color choices to contour the pattern of his facial fur, which both allow for more accentuated emotions.<ref name="Creature Shop" />

[[File:KelnaccaConcept-ArtOfTHRVol2.png|thumb|left|250px|Concept art by Louis Wiltshire]]
Scanlan felt that Kelnacca was more expressive than Chewbacca, which set him apart. Kelnacca had lighter and bushier eyebrows and a fuller mustache area than Chewbacca. He also had more ginger in his cheeks and the hair over his brows was longer, which Scanlan thought helped frame his face to where his eyes were. Scanlan wanted to distinguish Kelnacca from other Wookiees and give him a sense of individuality. One way this was done was by giving him a different hairstyle, which Scanlan described as an "[[Wikipedia:Adonis|Adonis]] sort of ponytail" and thought would be stunning when he let it down.<ref name="Art of Acolyte" /> 

Storyboards of the sequence involving Kelnacca and the scavengers were created by [[Jim Cornish]].<ref name="Storyboard">{{WebCite|url=https://www.jdcillustration.com/the-acolyte|text=The Acolyte|work=[https://www.jdcillustration.com/home JDC Illustration Ltd]|archivedate=20250320040832}}</ref> [[Vincent Jenkins]] created three pieces of concept art depicting Kelnacca and the other Jedi sitting together for the Brendok campfire scene.<ref name="Art of Acolyte" /><ref name="Vincent1">{{Instagram|username=vincentjenkinsjnr|url=p/C_BPeG1IH7N|name=[[Vincent Jenkins]]|date=2024-08-23|quote=Concept for Star Wars "The Acolyte" #starwars #conceptart #theacolyte #art|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/v7MWd|archivefile=File:VincentJenkins-BrendokJediFireside1post.png}}</ref><ref name="Vincent2">{{Instagram|username=vincentjenkinsjnr|url=p/C_IVODEiq5w|name=[[Vincent Jenkins]]|date=2024-08-26|quote=The Acolyte. Concept art #starwars #theacolyte #conceptart #painting #illustration|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/Hqf23|archivefile=File:VincentJenkins-BrendokJediFireside2post.png}}</ref> [[Barbra Araujo]] created concept art of Kelnacca in [[mission robes]]. Concept art of Mae finding Kelnacca's body was created by Adam Brockbank. [[Stephen Tappin]] created concept art of the Jedi in the Brendok courtyard. [[Louis Wiltshire]] created three pieces of concept art of Kelnacca,<ref name="Art of Acolyte" /> including a piece with a costume design by [[Jennifer Bryan]].<ref name="Art of THR 2">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The High Republic: Volume II]]''</ref> One of Wiltshire's pieces depicted Kelnacca with a blue lightsaber. Another of Wiltshire's pieces noted Kelnacca had one to two millimeters of stubble growth over his "tribal tattoos" and subtle scars on his face to add history. It also noted he had color variations on his nose and lip similar to dogs, cats, and lions. According to Wiltshire, Kelnacca was originally meant to have a shaven head, but it was decided that it looked too odd because his entire body was long hair.<ref name="Art of Acolyte" />

===Costume===
{{Quote|It's almost like I can see them — the way that they look and the costumes that they're wearing or any of those things. I'm a very visual person in that way. So that's how Kelnacca came to be.|Leslye Headland|<ref name="Entertainment" />}}
[[File:CursedKelnaccaCostume-SWI227.png|thumb|right|200px|Kelnacca's costume part-way through being styled]]
Kelnacca's Jedi robes were specially made by costume designer Jennifer Bryan and her team.<ref name="Creature Shop">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-creature-shop-bazil-reveal|text=Inside ''The Acolyte'' Creature Shop: Meet Bazil, the Tynnan Tracker - First Details}}</ref> The creature department worked on making Suotamo's costume more breathable to allow for the tremendous physicality needed for Kelnacca's fight scene.<ref name="Fight" /> Unlike Chewbacca, who had multiple suits, Kelnacca only had one suit,<ref name="InsiderCurls">{{InsiderCite|227|Creature Comforts (article)}}</ref> which was made from [[Wikipedia:Spandex|lycra]] with knotted in<ref name="Kaos" /> [[Wikipedia:Yak|yak]] hair. Because of this, there was always a team on set to keep the suit looking beautiful. Typically, there were two stylists working on it at a time, one on each side. To keep the curls looking consistent, everyone that worked on them was trained to do them in the same way.<ref name="InsiderCurls" /> Days on set usually lasted around ten hours, and Suotamo tried to go the full day without removing the suit, although he usually had to remove it once a day. However, Suotamo felt that the suit was not complicated and was fairly easy for him to take off.<ref name="Entertainment Reacts" />

[[File:KelnaccaMould-BrianBestInsta.jpg|thumb|left|200px|3D printed mould by Brian Best]]
For most scenes, Suotamo wore hair covered boots, which included details such as toenails. For stunts, he used special shoes, which were less detailed and were essentially sneakers covered in hair. A separate stunt mask was also used for hits and falls that involved closeups to avoid damaging the intricate facial servos inside the main mask. However, the majority of the costume was the same for stunt scenes, and only the shoes and mask were changed.<ref name="Kaos" />

[[Karl Gallivan]] worked as the lead mechanic on Kelnacca<ref name="Brian Best Instagram">{{Instagram|username=brianbestfx|url=/p/DCKeh61qz1V/?hl=en&img_index=1|name=[[Brian Best]]|quote=Kelnacca.  3D printed, GRP reinforced mould for casting Foam Latex skin pieces. The mould was expanded by 6% prior to printing, which allowed for the foam shrinkage accuracy worked out between myself and Karl Gallivan who was the lead mechanic on this character. Sculpture by Louis Wiltshire|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/WH9uA|archivefile=File:BrianBest-Kelnacca.png}}</ref> and engineered his facial animatronics, which were puppeteered by [[Steven Kynman]],<ref name="Steven Kynman Instagram">{{Instagram|username=stevenkynman|url=/p/C8J01mBIyBP/?hl=en|name=[[Steven Kynman]]|quote=All this I got to support by Puppeteering his facial animatronics that were brilliantly engineered by @karlgallivan Karl came up with some incredible stuff to make it work, yet be subtle and believable. There’s was a lot of love poured into this character. The hair punching and fabrication of the suit is such a skilled job and so many incredibly talented people went into making Kelnacca a reality.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/BHLSP|archivefile=File:StevenKynman-Kelnacca.png}}</ref> who was asked to work on the character in [[2022]].<ref name="Steven Kynman Instagram Date">{{Instagram|username=stevenkynman|url=/p/C71qDZuI5Hw/?hl=en|name=[[Steven Kynman]]|quote=Back in 2022, I was asked to puppeteer on a character that was…more involved than would normally be the case. I asked if I could think about it. “Sure, oh, by the way, the character’s a Wookiee, a Wookiee with a light sabre!”|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/iqwYm|archivefile=File:StevenKynman-Kelnacca-Instagram.png}}</ref> [[Brian Best]] created a 3D printed and [[Wikipedia:Fiberglass|glass reinforced plastic]] mould for casting foam latex skin pieces. Before printing, the mould was expanded by six percent to allow for foam shrinkage, a calculation worked out between Best and Gallivan. The sculpture was created by Louis Wiltshire.<ref name="Brian Best Instagram" />

===Filming===
{{Quote|And the Wookiee, it's worth noting, I refused to go in the communal areas because I didn't want to meet the Wookiee without his costume on.|Scroobius Pip|<ref name="Pip Podcast">{{Apple|subdomain=podcasts|url=us/podcast/the-acolyte-h-o-t-d-special-w-chris-distraction/id929136539?i=1000662459369|text=The Acolyte & H.O.T.D. Special (w/Chris) • Distraction Pieces Podcast with Scroobius Pip #577}}</ref>}}
[[File:ShinfieldStudios.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Scenes including Kelnacca were shot at Shinfield Studios.]]
When Kelnacca pulled away the scavenger Meevid's blaster, it was done by having a crew member stand on a ladder and pull it away with string. It took multiple takes to get the angle correct, and during one take, the blaster was broken and had to be repaired. [[Scroobius Pip]], who portrayed the scavenger, said it was important to him that he did not meet Suotamo without his Kelnacca costume on, and so he did not enter communal areas on set. According to Pip, Headland said the scene on Khofar was the best shot in<ref name="Pip Podcast" /> "Revenge / Justice."<ref name="Episode II" />

Khofar's sun was made of plywood and gold fabric and hit with light to create a blood-red effect. The sun set at the moment Kelnacca was found dead in his shelter by Mae. To amplify the tension of the scene, Tungsten Fresnel lights were put up on frames and dropped at the right moment.<ref name="Ars Technica">{{WebCite|url=https://arstechnica.com/culture/2024/06/star-wars-behind-the-scenes-creating-the-unique-aesthetic-of-the-acolyte|text=Star Wars behind the scenes: Creating the unique aesthetic of The Acolyte|work=[https://arstechnica.com/ Ars Technica.com]|archivedate=20250303214618}}</ref>

The campfire scene on Brendok was shot at [[Pinewood Studios]]<ref name="Location">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/lucasfilm-on-location-the-acolyte|text=Lucasfilm on Location: ''The Acolyte''}}</ref> in the United Kingdom,<ref name="Fantha Part II">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-2-uk|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 2: UK|archivedate=20250304030611}}</ref> and other scenes on Brendok were shot in [[Wikipedia:Wales|Wales]]. The entrance to the Brendok fortress was shot at Upper Neuadd Reservoir and Dam in Wales, and interior shots were filmed at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Location" /> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref> Interior shots of Kelnacca's shelter and the Jedi's transport ship were also shot at Shinfield Studios.<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> The site of the Jedi ship<ref name="BBC">{{WebCite|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx92exjz98ro|text=Star Wars show swaps galaxy far, far away for Wales|archivedate=20240714093614}}</ref> and the locations where the Jedi explored and catalogued Brendok<ref name="Fantha Part II" /> were also filmed at Upper Neuadd Reservoir.<ref name="Fantha Part II" /><ref name="BBC" /> Scenes in the Khofar forest were shot at Stage 1 of Arborfield Studios,<ref name="Art of Acolyte" /> an old military base in the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom]].<ref name="Kaos" />

===Fight sequence===
====Direction====
{{Quote|He's been trained, so every move should be trained. But when he's throwing those saber slashes out there, he's not in total control. So there was a balance there that I tried to follow.|Joonas Suotamo|<ref name="Kelnacca 1" />}}
[[File:ChristopherClarkCowan.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Action Director Christopher Clark Cowan directed Kelnacca's fight sequence.]]
"[[Choice]]," the seventh episode of ''The Acolyte'',<ref name="Kaos" /> which aired on [[July 9]], 2024,<ref name="Choice release date">{{DisneyPlus|subdomain=press|url=news/next-on-disney-plus-july-2024|text=Next on Disney+: July 2024}}</ref> featured a fight scene between Kelnacca and the other Jedi on Brendok.<ref name="Kaos" /> The fight sequence was directed by<ref name="Interview" /> Action Director<ref name="Fight" /> [[Christopher Clark Cowan]] and [[Kogonada]], the episode's director.<ref name="Interview" /> The scene was filmed in a warehouse at Arborfield Film Studios.<ref name="Kaos" /> Cowan had fun figuring out the fight sequence, but also described it as tricky. He took into account the sheer strength that a Wookiee would have in their strikes, saying that it meant a Wookiee would knock their opponent off balance in a straight clash. Cowan said that because the witches were inside Kelnacca's mind and drawing out his primal instincts, Kelnacca would be wild and animalistic during the fight, and he wanted him to be swinging wildly and not have immaculate form.<ref name="Fight" />

Suotamo was ecstatic to use a lightsaber and perform Kelnacca's fight sequence,<ref name="Fight">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-stunts-and-fights|text=Fight Like a Jedi: Inside <i>The Acolyte</i>'s Stunt Sequences and Martial Arts Action}}</ref> which he described as "thrilling".<ref name="Kaos" /> During the fight, he tried to strike a balance between Kelnacca's refined and well-trained posture and the aggressiveness he would have from not being in control.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" /> Suotamo initially had Kelnacca hesitate to fight against the other Jedi and then ended up channelling his full rage toward them.<ref name="Kaos" />

Suotamo enjoys fight scenes, and his goal is to make them look smooth and as a natural as possible. He also factored in the intent and emotions Wookiees have, and assumed them in his mentality when approaching the scene. Suotamo worked closely with [[Lee Jung-jae]] and [[Dean-Charles Chapman]], who portrayed Sol and Torbin, respectively, for the scene. They rehearsed the scene for several weeks, and Suotamo found it to be the most demanding part of the shoot. When filming, the set was busy and the ground had gravel that was not present during rehearsals, which they needed to adapt to. When Kelnacca returned to his senses, Suotamo wanted to convey that he had been in a dark place and not himself, but that everything cleared up and became serene for him again. He thought Kogonada liked his performance for that moment. Cowan had a vision for the scene, which Suotamo found easy to execute because of the instructions and feedback he was give.<ref name="Kaos" />

====Stunts====
{{Quote|I remember fretting over the actual takes. I knew it would be difficult, and we needed around two hours to film that scene. There were probably fifteen or twenty takes. I had a stunt harness, and different moves required a different number of attachments. I believe I had two or three wire attachments for my jump, because the crew needed to rotate me and lift me up.|Joonas Suotamo|<ref name="Kaos" />}}
[[File:SolVsKelnacca-Choice.png|thumb|right|275px|Suotamo performed all his own stunts during the fight sequence.]]
Suotamo did all his stunts himself, as no one else could fit inside the suit.<ref name="Interview" /> He worked with stunt coordinator [[Mark Ginther]] and fight coordinator [[Guillermo Grispo]] for the scene and praised the entire stunt team for helping with the performance. Suotamo began preparing for the scene with a stunt boot camp about one to two months before filming. He began with lightsaber choreography, starting with light warmups before moving to bigger moves. He explained that while working on major moves, he got better at the basics.<ref name="Kaos" /> The stunt team helped him learn the basic moves needed to execute the scene.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" /> While training, Suotamo said he had fun being able to try moves he had seen from the samurai video game [[Wikipedia:Ghost of Tsushima|''Ghost of Tsushima'']].<ref name="Celebration Day 1" />

For the scene when Indara tackled Kelnacca, Suotamo and Indara's stunt person, [[Katie McDonnell]], rehearsed for a long time to verify they would get the leg grab and fall correct.<ref name="Kaos" /> Suotamo noted that while his lightsaber's [[Lightsaber hilt|hilt]] did not weigh much, the blade was much heavier. He credited his experience as a basketball player for giving him a basic foundation for the stunt work, noting it helped him with the ability to command his body to do the required movements relatively quickly. When Kelnacca kicked through a stone wall, only one take could be done, so there was pressure on Suotamo. However, he found the scene fun and described the way the wall broke as "beautiful." He also enjoyed the scene in which Kelnacca threw Torbin and pinned him to a wall. The scene involved wire work, as Suotamo could not lift Chapman with only one hand.<ref name="Kaos" />

Suotamo said that the leap in the scene may have been one of his favorites shots of all time. He at first did not think he was going to be able to pull it off, and he had to first fail multiple times and then improve once he saw how it looked.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" /> The jump took about two hours to film and around fifteen to twenty takes. Because of the extensive number of takes, Suotamo and the crew knew that everything had worked on the final take. Suotamo wore a stunt harness and had a different number of attachments for different moves. For the leap, he believed he had two or three wire attachments, which the crew used to lift and rotate him.<ref name="Kaos" />

===Comics and continuity===
{{Quote|Kelnacca is the perfect character to bridge the gap between the time of Leslye Headland’s spectacular series to the age of Starlight Beacon, the threat of Marchion Ro, and the marauding Nihil.|Cavan Scott|<ref name="ComicReveal" />}}
[[File:TheAcolyte-Kelnacca-1-Final-Cover.jpg|thumb|left|220px|''The Acolyte - Kelnacca'' 1 connected ''The Acolyte'' with other High Republic media]]
Kelnacca also appeared in [[The Acolyte - Kelnacca 1|''The Acolyte - Kelnacca'' 1]], a one-shot [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] which released on [[September 4]], 2024, and was written by [[Cavan Scott]] with art by [[Marika Cresta]]. In an interview, Scott said that he was excited to connect ''The Acolyte'' with previous High Republic media and that Kelnacca was the perfect character to do so.<ref name="ComicReveal" /> Suotamo was instrumental in helping Scott and the creative team understand Kelnacca. During an early brainstorming call for the comic, Suotamo offered input on Kelnacca's character and what he embodies. He also explained to the team how he portrayed Kelnacca, and the similarities and differences between his portrayals of Chewbacca and Kelnacca.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" />

Kelnacca also appears in Scott's [[2025]] comic series ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic – Fear of the Jedi]]'', published as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project's [[Phase III: Trials of the Jedi|Phase III]]. In an interview, Scott explained that although he was aware of Kelnacca's fate in ''The Acolyte'', it did not factor in much to how he fleshed out the character's backstory. Scott also said that Kelnacca was fun to write<ref name="Fear Reveal">{{WebCite|url=https://comicbook.com/comics/news/cavan-scott-star-wars-the-high-republic-fear-of-the-jedi-interview|text=Star Wars: Cavan Scott Reveals What Scares the Jedi in The High Republic Phase III Finale|archivedate=20250117172558}}</ref> and that he loves writing Wookiees. Scott knew he wanted to bring Kelnacca into the project as soon as he saw early pictures from ''The Acolyte'' and liked being able to add additional interconnectivity to the High Republic Era.<ref name="Wook Interview">{{WookCite|url=p/4400000000003908470|text=Interview with Cavan Scott|forum=1}}</ref>

[[Phil Noto]]'s cover of the [[The High Republic – Fear of the Jedi 1|first issue]] of ''Fear of the Jedi'',<ref name="Fear of the Jedi 1" /> which released on [[February 19]], 2025,<ref name="Fear of the Jedi 1 Release Date">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/122247/star_wars_the_high_republic_-_fear_of_the_jedi_2025_1|text=Star Wars: The High Republic - Fear of the Jedi (2025) #1}}</ref> depicts Kelnacca with his tattoos.<ref name="Fear of the Jedi 1" /> However, ''The Acolyte - Kelnacca'' 1 established he did not receive his tattoos until after Yarzion Vell was knighted,<ref name="Kelnacca 1" /> and the comic depicts Vell as still being Kelnacca's Padawan. The rest of the issue correctly depicts him without his tattoos.<ref name="Fear of the Jedi 1" /> In ''[[The High Republic: Into the Light]]'', a young-adult novel by [[Claudia Gray]]<ref name="Into the Light" /> that was published on [[April 1]], 2025,<ref name="Edelweiss">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/764032/star-wars-the-high-republic-into-the-light-by-claudia-gray|text=Star Wars: The High Republic: Into the Light}}</ref> as part of Phase III,<ref name="ITL Phase">{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-star-wars-the-high-republic-panel|text=SWCE 2023: 9 Things We Learned from the ''Star Wars: The High Republic'' Panel}}</ref> Kelnacca is described as a Jedi Knight.<ref name="Into the Light" /> ''The Acolyte - Kelnacca'' 1 established that Kelnacca would be a Jedi Master prior to the time of the novel's events.<ref name="Kelnacca 1" />
